summary: Craze & Crash, motion night: our only two Shorts with drop points both lose the most viewers 2 s into beat 2, where the picture rate halves, so I queued a look challenger. Added two founder-bet Shorts (Airbnb's $40 cereal, FedEx's blackjack win) and proposed fixing the market scan's off-niche search.
why: Stanley loses 19 points at 5.5 s and Nokia 37 points at 5.8 s. Both hooks change picture every ~1.3 s, then beat 2 holds 1-2 layers for 4.5-5.6 s. The core founder_bet lane had one open topic. 24 of the 25 market breakouts were off-niche.

findings.title: Viewers leave where the picture slows after the hook
findings.detail: Stanley -19 points at 5.5 s, Nokia -37 points at 5.8 s, both in beat 2 with 1-2 layers over 4.5-5.6 s after a hook of 3 layers in 3.8 s; challenger doc-beat2-cut-rate

findings.title: The market scan's 'what happened to' search is off-niche
findings.detail: 24 of the 25 Shorts breakouts on 24 Nov are football, Roblox, K-pop or horror; proposal market-queries-on-niche

findings.title: Airbnb's $40 cereal boxes
findings.detail: More than 1,000 boxes made $30,000; then Y Combinator put in $20,000 for 6% (Chesky, via CNBC)

findings.title: FedEx's $5,000 blackjack night
findings.detail: With $5,000 left, Smith won $27,000, then raised $11M; FedEx's FY2026 revenue was $94.7B
